title: Weekly sync: serving-runtime / infra / console — agenda + action items (2026-05-11)
content:
Meeting: Weekly cross-team sync (serving-runtime / infra / console)
Date: 2026-05-11 10:00-10:45 PT (30-45m)
Location: Zoom / #eng-serving-runtime Slack channel
Attendees (expected): Ava (notes), Marcus (serving-runtime), Priya (infra), Diego (console), Sofia (SRE), plus whoever's oncall

Purpose / Goals for this meeting:
- Keep alignment across runtime, infra, and console on rolling deploys + canary rules.
- Surface any cross-cutting regressions (latency/cost) and coordinate mitigations.
- Track action items and owners; remove blockers for Dedicated rollout.

Agenda (45m)
1) Quick status (round-robin) — 12m total (3m each)
   - Marcus: serving-runtime weekly highlights (perf numbers, PRs ready for rollout)
   - Priya: infra capacity + autoscaler tweaks, Dedicated pool status
   - Diego: console rollout for new rollout UI, telemetry hooks
   - Sofia: SRE incident postmortem follow-ups, oncall gaps

2) Deep-dive: prefix/KV cache regression after latest kernel selection change — 12m
   - Symptoms: 15% median latency increase for <64-token requests on Batching-optimized hosts (see RI-2345).
   - Quick ask: Marcus to summarize root cause and immediate mitigations; Priya to confirm infra-level hotspot scheduling.

3) Canary plan for model-variant fallback (Dedicated customers) — 8m
   - Decision: enable staged canary for fallback to 8-bit quantized variant when hot hosts are saturated.
   - Diego to validate console UI flow for toggling fallback per-customer.

4) Action-item review + next steps — 8m

5) Parking lot / AOB — 5m

Notes to self / draft talking points (Ava)
- Remind team: Shipping rollout flag requires both runtime + console toggles (PRs linked below).
- Highlight customer: acme-payments reported elevated tail latency on Dedicated pool (support ticket #ACME-78).
- Ask: Need an SLI to measure cache hit-rate per-model-per-host; if not available, prioritize in next sprint.

Quick updates (prep items to be updated before meeting)
- Marcus (serving-runtime):
  * PRs: kernel-selection fallback fix (PR 421) — tests passing in canary; needs perf runs on p4-16; summary: small change in kernel selector that regresses short sequence path.
  * Perf: 95th p50 p95 numbers attached in Confluence page (linked).
  * Risk: rollout without prefix cache fix can impact PLG customers using short-chat flows.

- Priya (infra):
  * Capacity: Dedicated pool at 82% commit usage; autoscaler config v2 staged.
  * Infra work: scheduler tweak to spread KV-heavy shards; rolling deploy scheduled 2026-05-13 if no regressions.
  * Blocker: need runtime telemetry hook to surface host-level KV pressure (see action RI-2356).

- Diego (console):
  * Rollout UI: feature-flagged; UX review complete; backend toggle depends on new API endpoint (serving-runtime PR 421).
  * Telemetry: added new trace spans for rollback decisions; confirm tags align with SRE expectations.

- Sofia (SRE):
  * Incidents: small outage 2026-05-06 due to autoscaler flapping; postmortem draft in Confluence (link).
  * Ask: Can we add a quick circuit-breaker to reduce risk of cascading autoscaler changes?

Blockers (to surface)
- RI-2345: prefix/KV cache regression (owner: Marcus) — blocking rollout of kernel-selection change.
- RI-2356: host KV pressure telemetry (owner: Priya) — blocks reliable debugging on prod.
- ACME-78: customer latency complaint on Dedicated (owner: Ava for customer liaison, but needs eng triage).

Action items (tracking style — single-line per item with status)
- Marcus Lee — finalize kernel-selection fallback and push hotfix to canary; perf runs on p4-16; due: 2026-05-12; status: in_progress
- Priya Patel — add host-level KV-pressure metric and expose via telemetry pipeline (RI-2356); due: 2026-05-18; status: open
- Diego Ramirez — wire console toggle to new API and add canary option in UI; draft PR by 2026-05-14; status: in_progress
- Sofia Nguyen — propose autoscaler circuit-breaker thresholds and file RI ticket; due: 2026-05-13; status: open
- Ava Thompson — respond to ACME support ticket with interim mitigation and schedule deep-dive with customer; due: 2026-05-12; status: open
- Marcus Lee & Priya Patel — run coordinated canary (runtime+infra) for rollback path on 2026-05-13 and report results in Slack; due: 2026-05-14; status: planned

Parking lot / follow-ups (not for this week's agenda unless urgent)
- Quantization guidance doc update for Dedicated customers (product request).
- Long-term: per-tenant cache quotas design (architectural doc).

Links / artifacts to reference during the meeting:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/RI-weekly-sync-overview
- JIRA: RI-2345 (prefix/KV cache regression), RI-2356 (telemetry), RI-2360 (canary plan)
- GitHub: serving-runtime PR 421 https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/421
- Support ticket: ACME-78 (internal link in Zendesk)

Notes to self (scratch):
- If Marcus is blocked by perf infra, escalate to infra-ops channel and loop in Priya.
- Keep the meeting tight — prefer async updates for anything that doesn't need cross-team coordination.

-- end of draft agenda (will update with live notes during sync)
